## Overview

**John** is one of the **Four Blood Brothers** — the knights who rose from the crowd at Aegon's trial to stand beside him in the **Judgment of Five**. He fought with Aegon, survived, and now serves as a commander in the new **Order of the Protectors**.

Known for his steadfast loyalty and measured counsel. He was gravely wounded during the initial jousting charge but survived.

---

## Current Status

Separated from Aegon — operating in another region on a separate mission for the Protectors. His survival and location are unknown to the Scales.
